evals.name: Clean Payroll Data
evals.description: Clean payroll with minimal issues - should score 10-15 risk score (Low Risk)
evals.scenario: Standard monthly payroll processing with complete data and accurate calculations
test_steps: Verify Executive Summary shows Low Risk
Verify Critical Findings sheet is empty or minimal

evals.name: Payroll with Compliance Violations
evals.description: Payroll with multiple compliance violations - should score 55-70 (High Risk)
evals.scenario: Payroll with critical data quality, calculation, and compliance issues requiring management review

expected_issues: SS wage base exceeded with continued withholding
Overtime rate at 1.25x instead of 1.5x FLSA
Zero or negative net pay from excessive deductions

test_steps: Verify 'SS Wage Base Exceeded' check fails (employee with YTD $180K still has SS withholding)
Verify 'Garnishment Limit' check fails (employee at 30% of disposable, exceeds 25%)
Verify 'Overtime Rate Validation' check fails (1.25x instead of 1.5x FLSA)
Verify 'Duplicate Employee Records' check fails (2 duplicate records)
Verify 'Unusually High Payments' check fails (>3 std dev from mean)
Verify 'Missing Department' check fails (3 employees with null department)
Verify 'Tax Withholding Anomaly' check fails (3% effective rate on $12K gross)
Verify 'Zero Net Pay' check fails (deductions exceed gross)
Verify Critical Findings sheet lists all critical items
Verify Affected Employees sheet identifies all employees with issues
Verify risk level in Executive Summary is High Risk

evals.name: Pre-Production Validation with Prior Period
evals.description: Pre-production validation comparing to prior period - should score 35-50 (Medium Risk) with prior period anomalies
evals.scenario: Go-live payroll validation with significant payroll variance and headcount changes
test_steps: Verify Prior Period Comparison checks are present
Verify 'Total Payroll Variance' check shows >10% variance
Verify 'Average Pay Variance' check shows significant change
Run generate_audit_report.py with prior period included
Verify Prior Period Comparison worksheet exists
Verify audit report includes variance analysis
Verify Executive Summary risk score calculation is correct
